'''Wing-song''' was the native language of the [[S'krrr (species)|S'krrr]]. It was created by the S'rrr rubbing their vestigial wings together to create tonal inflections.<ref name="AJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Combat Moon (short story)}}</ref>
